findings.summary: adb shell input text unreliable on EMUI 9 for Flutter fields: observed double-insert (50008 -> '5000850008'; 18-char pwd -> 36 dots) and total loss (text stayed '56321'). Not an app defect; blocks adb-driven credential entry.
findings.decision: journey execution moves to integration_test channel (Flutter semantic driver, bypasses IME) per contract's spec->catalog->inventory chain

findings.summary: App phone-tab emits +86-prefixed account (+8613800000001) for getcode/login; curl fixtures registered bare 13800000001. Backend stores/queries mobile verbatim, so a +86 login cannot match a bare-number user ('账号不存在'). App-registered users are self-consistent; fixtures must be created via App path or with +86 format.
findings.decision: fixture accounts for journeys will be created through the App/integration_test path; res-synth-acc fixtures remain for API-level tests with bare-number shape

findings.summary: After tapping login, screencap returned constant 7701-byte black frames while uiautomator dump still showed the login fields; no app logcat output under default buffers on EMUI 9. Surface capture limitation/IME state on this device; no crash (MainActivity focused throughout).
findings.decision: use integration_test takeScreenshot for in-journey evidence instead of host-side screencap
